title: BUGFIX — Gitignore auto-delivered.jsonl to prevent git-clobber re-delivery
rationale: auto-delivered.jsonl is tracked by git. When git restore/checkout runs (e.g. during sprint commits or manual operations), it overwrites the file to its last committed state, losing delivery records for all videos delivered since that commit. Result: auto-deliver re-sends those videos on the next run. Confirmed: 3 v2 videos delivered on 2026-03-24 morning were re-delivered on 2026-03-25 noon. Fix: gitignore the file + untrack it. It is append-only runtime state — git has no business touching it.

tasks.description: Add workspace/scs001/auto-delivered.jsonl to .gitignore and run git rm --cached to untrack it. This prevents git restore/checkout from clobbering delivery history.
